description: Long document summarizer — Summarizes long documents up to 120,000 characters (about 30 pages) with map-reduce: each ~12k-char section is condensed by AI, then combined into a final summary. Pass url= (any web page or text file) or text=. Options: length=short|medium|long, focus= (what to pay attention to). Returns title, summary, key points, key facts (numbers, names, dates), topics, audience, section count. For PDFs use /v1/ai/summarize-pdf. Price: $0.04 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_summarize_long
